title: Instructions for Form 8990 (12/2025), Limitation on Business Interest Expense

passages.question: Is the business interest limited?
passages.excerpt: For tax years beginning in 2025, a taxpayer meets the gross receipts test if the taxpayer has average annual gross receipts of $31 million or less for the 3 prior tax years ... P.L. 119-21 ... amended section 163(j) to allow an add-back to taxable income for any deduction allowable for depreciation, amortization, or depletion to determine ATI for tax years beginning after 2024.
